name: Alert
summary: Add your proficiency bonus to initiative, and you can swap initiative with a willing ally.

name: Magic Initiate
summary: Learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from the Cleric, Druid or Wizard list.

name: Savage Attacker
summary: Once per turn, roll a weapon's damage dice twice and use either result.

name: Skilled
summary: Gain proficiency in any three skills or tools.

name: Archery
summary: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

name: Great Weapon Fighting
summary: With two-handed melee weapons, treat damage dice rolls of 1 or 2 as 3.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
summary: Add your ability modifier to the damage of your extra light weapon attack.
